scope: Diagnostic of all three stopped v9 runs; no new model execution. Stream messages and tool IDs are deduplicated. Parent input includes cache; these counts are not reconciled full-session usage and do not replace recorded totals. Different behavior across trials is observational, not causal proof.
findings: All parents begin with approximately 23k input tokens before reading the Skill; Skill byte reduction cannot remove this existing Host/prompt context.

Parent pre-reading of the reviewer reference occurred in baseline and failed candidate, but not the completed candidate. Existing Skill already tells the parent not to pre-read unless needed for implementation.
Failed candidate required a SendMessage correction of the reviewer commit spelling. Latest evaluator fix accepts uniquely resolved abbreviations but does not permit stale or unfinished reviews.
Do not add another generic batching instruction: the existing Skill already supplies it. A later experiment must isolate an executable change rather than repeat these trials until they pass.
